purpose: Teach: 乗り出し/幾何/高揚/恣意/乖離/排他/占拠/屈辱

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、捜査に乗り出した時期を市民に説明されますね
lines.en: The police will need to explain to the public when they began investigating this case, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured inquiry. Slightly deferential—Ren is checking his understanding with the officer, not challenging. Soft uplift at the end on the rising particle. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の幾何学的配置を分析します
lines.en: The police will analyze the geometric layout of the scene.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact statement. Professional cadence. No performance—just stating standard procedure. Slight emphasis on 'analyze' as a concrete action. Grounded, steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の高揚感が引き起こした行動を警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: So the police have grasped how the victim's heightened emotional state prompted their actions in this case, haven't they?
lines.style: Tentative and genuinely inquisitive. Ren is thinking aloud, feeling his way toward understanding. Pause after 'victim's state'—he's connecting dots. Trailing slight uncertainty at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、恣意的な捜査は絶対にしません
lines.en: The police will never conduct an investigation with bias or arbitrary judgment.
lines.style: Firm, resolute. Officer Takeda's voice carries quiet conviction—this is non-negotiable principle. Slight weight on 'never.' Professional but warm, reassuring without softening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、当初の計画と実態の乖離を警察、確認されたんですね
lines.en: The police have confirmed the gap between the initial plan and what actually happened in this case, then?
lines.style: Questioning but not doubting. Ren's voice rises slightly at the end—he's seeking confirmation of what he suspects. Intelligent, careful in his phrasing. A pause before 'gap.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、排他的な犯罪グループを摘発します
lines.en: The police will dismantle the exclusionary criminal group.
lines.style: Direct statement of intent. Measured, with underlying gravity. Officer Takeda speaks with quiet authority—this is about action and follow-through. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、建物の占拠事案を警察、解決されましたね
lines.en: So the police have resolved the building occupation incident in this case, haven't they?
lines.style: Slightly relieved exhale on opening. Ren's asking for confirmation of resolution. Softer than before—acknowledging closure. Gentle upturn at the end, seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の屈辱を癒すケアにも配慮します
lines.en: The police are attentive to healing the victim's sense of violation—it's part of our care.
lines.style: Warmth emerges—Officer Takeda's professional mask softens slightly. Slower pace here. 'Healing' carries tenderness. He's speaking from conviction about duty that extends beyond procedure. Genuine.
